admission.rule: current Catalog route exists AND canonical identity resolved AND adapter contract exists AND required task capability evidence exists AND status != blocked

tt-image-2.current_gap: Exact current identity and dedicated adapter contract are present; exact-id Provider evidence for reference-generate is absent.
tt-image-2.offline_only: Existing contract fixtures can prove request compilation, exact binding, size/quality mapping and Governor precedence, but cannot prove the current route accepts and completes the request.
tt-image-2.minimum_canary: One explicit max_attempts=1 run with one exact Result reference, packaging text/logo protection, 1:1 at 2K; retain request, receipt, actual pixels, Result and lineage.
tt-image-2.admission_boundary: Only reference-generate becomes eligible from this canary; no legacy gpt-image-2 evidence is inherited.

banana-2.current_gap: Current route and exact canonical identity exist, but PA only has the generic-image compatibility fallback, not a banana-specific adapter contract.
banana-2.offline_only: Catalog-declared images/aspectRatio/imageSize can support a model-family adapter and complete request, parameter, Governor, exact binding, response-fixture and receipt gates without a Provider call.
banana-2.minimum_canary: After adapter/offline Gate, one explicit max_attempts=1 run with one exact Result reference and packaging text/logo protection at 1:1 and 2K.
banana-2.composer_value: high; second priority as a speed/cost-oriented manual choice
banana-2.admission_boundary: Banana marketing or Gemini legacy names provide no evidence inheritance.

banana-pro.current_gap: Current route and exact canonical identity exist, but PA only has the generic-image compatibility fallback, not a banana-specific adapter contract.
banana-pro.offline_only: Catalog-declared images/aspectRatio/imageSize can support a model-family adapter and complete 1K/2K/4K parameter, Governor, exact binding, response-fixture and receipt gates without a Provider call.
banana-pro.minimum_canary: After adapter/offline Gate, one explicit max_attempts=1 run with one exact Result reference and packaging text/logo protection at 1:1 and 2K.
banana-pro.composer_value: high; quality-oriented manual choice after the shared parameter-family adapter is closed
banana-pro.admission_boundary: It requires a separate exact-id canary; banana-2 or Gemini legacy evidence is not reusable.

boundaries: Admission is task-scoped; it does not imply support for text-to-image, edit-current-image or variant.
Source-free text-to-image remains blocked by the existing Overlay and is not changed by this plan.
No Composer UI, routing policy, historical evidence, adapter implementation or schema was changed.
No Provider generation endpoint was called and no promotion was performed.
